method: Read-only pinned Git objects. Static declarations/literals only; no host or plugin execution. Counts are scope evidence, not runtime coverage or compatibility acceptance.

backend.note: Includes unmounted declarations; excludes runtime plugin APIs and routes declared outside app/api/endpoints. Reconcile actual OpenAPI and each consumed operation during its implementation leaf.

plugins.note: Methods may be inherited; components/expressions may be generated in helper files. Third-party and installed legacy plugins require their own sanitized runtime fixtures.
